instruction.text: Find all the conjunctions in the text.

atoms.b: On Saturday, I will have a party ((because)) it is my birthday.
atoms.sound: On Saturday, I will have a party because it is my birthday.

atoms.b: I invited all my friends from school ((and)) some kids from our village.
atoms.sound: I invited all my friends from school and some kids from our village.

atoms.b: It will be sunny, ((so)) we will have a garden party.
atoms.sound: It will be sunny, so we will have a garden party.

atoms.b: My dad asked me ((if)) I wanted to have a clown at my party, ((but)) I said no.
atoms.sound: My dad asked me if I wanted to have a clown at my party, but I said no.

atoms.b: I want to play games with my friends ((after)) eating cake.
atoms.sound: I want to play games with my friends after eating cake.

atoms.b: I will give every guest a party bag ((before)) they leave.
atoms.sound: I will give every guest a party bag before they leave.

instruction.text: Fill in the gap with the correct conjunction.

atoms.b: I will go swimming, ((++or but)) I will visit my grandma.
I ate all the food ((although ++because)) I was very hungry.
She was tired, ((++so or)) she took a nap.
I want to play, ((so ++but)) I need to do my homework instead.
